test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said, “It is my birthday next week.”

options.text: She said that my birthday was next week.
She said that it is my birthday the following week.
She said that it was her birthday the following week.
She said that next week was her birthday.

solution:
​The correct answer is **'****She said that it was her birthday the following week'.**
